cases.label: 명시적 제출은 trim 값으로 즉시 검색하고 예약 중복을 없앤다
cases.probe: const form=document.createElement('form');const label=document.createElement('label');const input=document.createElement('input');input.name='query';input.id='query-input';input.type='search';input.required=true;input.setAttribute('aria-describedby','query-help');label.htmlFor=input.id;label.textContent='검색어';const help=document.createElement('p');help.id='query-help';help.textContent='상품 이름을 입력하세요.';const error=document.createElement('p');error.id='query-error';error.dataset.error='';const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='submit';button.textContent='검색';form.append(label,input,help,error,button);document.body.append(form);const searches=[];let controller;try{controller=submission.mountSearchForm(form,value=>searches.push(value),10);if(typeof controller?.dispose!=='function')throw new Error('Missing dispose method');input.value=' Lemon ';input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));const event=new SubmitEvent('submit',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true});form.dispatchEvent(event);const immediate=searches.length;await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));observe({searches,immediate,prevented:event.defaultPrevented,value:input.value,error:error.textContent,invalid:input.getAttribute('aria-invalid')});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();form.remove();}

cases.label: requestSubmit 경로와 네이티브 patternMismatch를 확인한다
cases.probe: const form=document.createElement('form');const label=document.createElement('label');const input=document.createElement('input');input.name='query';input.id='query-input';input.type='search';input.required=true;input.setAttribute('aria-describedby','query-help');label.htmlFor=input.id;label.textContent='검색어';const help=document.createElement('p');help.id='query-help';help.textContent='상품 이름을 입력하세요.';const error=document.createElement('p');error.id='query-error';error.dataset.error='';const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='submit';button.textContent='검색';form.append(label,input,help,error,button);document.body.append(form);const searches=[];let controller;try{controller=submission.mountSearchForm(form,value=>searches.push(value),10);if(typeof controller?.dispose!=='function')throw new Error('Missing dispose method');input.pattern='[0-9]+';input.value='ABC';form.addEventListener('submit',event=>event.preventDefault(),{capture:true});form.requestSubmit();observe({searches,mismatch:input.validity.patternMismatch,focused:document.activeElement===input,error:error.textContent,customError:input.validity.customError});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();form.remove();}

cases.label: 빠른 연속 입력은 마지막 값만 한 번 검색한다
cases.probe: const form=document.createElement('form');const label=document.createElement('label');const input=document.createElement('input');input.name='query';input.id='query-input';input.type='search';input.required=true;input.setAttribute('aria-describedby','query-help');label.htmlFor=input.id;label.textContent='검색어';const help=document.createElement('p');help.id='query-help';help.textContent='상품 이름을 입력하세요.';const error=document.createElement('p');error.id='query-error';error.dataset.error='';const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='submit';button.textContent='검색';form.append(label,input,help,error,button);document.body.append(form);const searches=[];let controller;try{controller=submission.mountSearchForm(form,value=>searches.push(value),10);if(typeof controller?.dispose!=='function')throw new Error('Missing dispose method');for(const value of ['L','Le',' Lemon ']){input.value=value;input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));}const before=searches.length;await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));observe({before,searches,value:input.value});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();form.remove();}

cases.label: 조합 시작은 이전 예약을 취소하고 조합 중 제출을 막는다
cases.probe: const form=document.createElement('form');const label=document.createElement('label');const input=document.createElement('input');input.name='query';input.id='query-input';input.type='search';input.required=true;input.setAttribute('aria-describedby','query-help');label.htmlFor=input.id;label.textContent='검색어';const help=document.createElement('p');help.id='query-help';help.textContent='상품 이름을 입력하세요.';const error=document.createElement('p');error.id='query-error';error.dataset.error='';const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='submit';button.textContent='검색';form.append(label,input,help,error,button);document.body.append(form);const searches=[];let controller;try{controller=submission.mountSearchForm(form,value=>searches.push(value),10);if(typeof controller?.dispose!=='function')throw new Error('Missing dispose method');input.value='old';input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));input.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionstart',{bubbles:true}));input.value='ㅎ';input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,isComposing:true}));const event=new SubmitEvent('submit',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true});form.dispatchEvent(event);await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));const during=searches.length;input.value='한글';input.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionend',{bubbles:true,data:'한글'}));input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,isComposing:false}));await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));observe({during,searches,prevented:event.defaultPrevented,value:input.value});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();form.remove();}

cases.label: invalid 입력은 이전 검색을 취소하고 타이핑 경로에서 focus를 빼앗지 않는다
cases.probe: const form=document.createElement('form');const label=document.createElement('label');const input=document.createElement('input');input.name='query';input.id='query-input';input.type='search';input.required=true;input.setAttribute('aria-describedby','query-help');label.htmlFor=input.id;label.textContent='검색어';const help=document.createElement('p');help.id='query-help';help.textContent='상품 이름을 입력하세요.';const error=document.createElement('p');error.id='query-error';error.dataset.error='';const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='submit';button.textContent='검색';form.append(label,input,help,error,button);document.body.append(form);const searches=[];let controller;try{controller=submission.mountSearchForm(form,value=>searches.push(value),10);if(typeof controller?.dispose!=='function')throw new Error('Missing dispose method');button.focus();input.value='valid';input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));input.value='x'.repeat(41);input.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));observe({searches,buttonFocused:document.activeElement===button,error:error.textContent,customError:input.validity.customError,valueLength:input.value.length});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();form.remove();}
